note: The engine's DEFAULT profile — used when a project's Durable Object has none, and when the control plane cannot be reached. Every agent names all three parts: harness (how we drive it), provider (whose account pays), model (what runs). Credentials never live here; they come from the vault, per provider.

claude-code-pty.text: claude-code-pty drives the CLI through a pseudo-terminal: every turn runs a terminal session, which costs far more per question than an API harness. Fine for the analyst, which runs rarely and builds from scratch; expensive for the composer, which runs on every question.
